standard_prerequisites.name: Permanence block for flat and finitely presented morphisms
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, lemmas composition-finite-presentation, composition-flat, etale-flat, etale-locally-finite-presentation, fppf-open (cross-chapter, named block)
standard_prerequisites.use: The compositions f_{ij} are flat, lfp and open.

standard_prerequisites.name: A-fortiori chain for the smaller topologies
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-zariski-etale-smooth-syntomic-fppf (same chapter, NOT carded, declared external)

core_obligations: Flatness of the fppf covering members checks condition (1) of the fpqc definition.
For condition (2): let V -> U be affine; choose affine etale coverings {V_{ij} -> V x_U U_i}; the compositions f_{ij}: V_{ij} -> V are flat and lfp by the permanence block, hence open.
|V| is the open union of the f_{ij}(|V_{ij}|); quasi-compactness of |V| yields a finite refinement V_{i_1 j_1}, ..., V_{i_N j_N}.
{V_{i_k j_k} -> V} is a standard fpqc covering refining {U_i x_U V -> V}; conclude, then add the a-fortiori chain.
proof_roadmap: Definition check part (1); open-cover finite refinement for part (2); a-fortiori assembly.
difficulty_reason: The open-cover plus quasi-compact finite refinement is a genuine argument, not a definition check.
